external_dictionary_review.notes: External dictionary search returned temporary service errors during this work unit. Generation uses the repository lexicon senses below; this file does not claim independent lexical approval.

freshness_method: Guarded promotion must check all selected target IDs against canonical Urdu A1, A2, and B1 sequences 1-36 immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: trust or confidence in another person
deception or a misleading act that damages trust
dignity, standing, or self-respect in social interaction
tone or manner of speaking, including vocal attitude
a word or uttered expression in a conversation
a person living nearby; a neighbor
goodwill, welfare, or an action intended for another person's good
misled or led toward an incorrect understanding
hidden, concealed, or not immediately visible
a threat intended to pressure or frighten another person
heightened agitation or provoked emotional intensity

generation_guardrails: P1-P5 introduce exactly three new targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all fifteen.
All six passages retain ten questions and ten linked answers and remain within the 220-320 whitespace-token B1 band.
Learner-facing title, passage text, questions, and answers use Urdu script only.
Relationship scenarios teach clarification, consent, boundaries, trust repair, and de-escalation without coercive or retaliatory advice.
No single interpersonal conflict is treated as proof of another person's motives; ambiguous intent is explicitly distinguished from observable behavior.
Guarded promotion fails closed on target-ID freshness collisions, schema drift, QA-link errors, script leakage, or state mismatch.
Generation/integrity status remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
